params.name: market
params.description:
The source market code.

Accepted values: dk, fi, no, se.

params.name: adults
params.description:
Number of Adults in the request.

Accepted Values - 1 to 6

params.name: childages
params.description:
Ages of Children in the request separated by comma. If no children are sent in the request, this parameter should not be sent (or sent as ?childAges=).

For 2 children with age 5 and 7, the value should be 5,7.
Age ranges are, infant: 0-1, child: 2-12, youth: 13-17.

params.name: destinations
params.description:
The G-code value for each destination that is mapped through the locations endpoint.
Multiple destinations can be sent in the request separated by comma.

Example: G-000000234,G-000000256,G-000000293,G-000000293

params.name: arrivaldatefrom
params.description: Date of arrival from. Date must be compatible with ISO 8601. Example: arrivaldatefrom=2035-01-31

params.name: arrivaldateto
params.description:
Date of arrival to.
Date must be compatible with ISO 8601.

Example: arrivaldateto=2035-01-31

params.name: durations
params.description: A list of one or more stay durations. Example: 3,5,7,14

params.name: airportcodes
params.description:
A list of airportcodes separated by comma that are requested by user as Departure locations.

Example: ARN,GOT,CPH

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of items to return. Maximum: 100.
